title: Enemy reversal produces zero-direction freeze
explanation: At frame 262 an enemy_reversed_at_wall event reports old_direction=0.0 and new_direction=0.0, which should never occur for a legitimate wall hit. No later state_snapshot shows the enemy moving, indicating it remains frozen (vel_x stays 0.0). This contradicts the intended reversal behavior where direction must change. The freeze persists through subsequent frames (e.g., player_moved at frame 287 shows no enemy movement).
